info.title: OpenVie API
info.description: OpenVie API — multi-workspace document intelligence. Authenticate with a Bearer JWT from `/api/v1/auth/login` (or `sso/exchange`, `refresh`, `workspaces/switch`). The active workspace (tenant), user, and role are resolved from the token attributes on every request — no tenant header is used. Endpoints marked with a padlock require this scheme; public auth and setup endpoints are unlocked. Most failures answer with the standard error body (timestamp, status, path, error, message); chat resources answer with `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id"}}`.

post.summary: Send a message and get the answer
post.description: Runs one answer generation. Two response modes: `Accept: application/json` waits for the final answer and returns it as JSON (server-to-server integration mode, bounded by the model answer deadline); any other Accept (or none) streams `text/event-stream` frames: `content` (draft previews, each replacing the previous), `reset` (the provider restarted the draft), `complete` (the authoritative answer with citations), and `error` (a failure code). Keepalive comments every 5 s; the stream cancels on client disconnect. An optional `Idempotency-Key` header replays the same turn in either mode. `document_ids` in the body narrows retrieval to at most 20 COMPLETED documents of the session's knowledge base; empty or absent means the whole knowledge base.

200.description: SSE stream opened; terminal event is `complete` or `error`

404.description: SESSION_NOT_FOUND — the session id, even when an Idempotency-Key replays a different session

502.description: MODEL_PROVIDER_ERROR — the inference pipeline failed mid-answer

document_ids.description: Optional retrieval scope: at most 20 document ids, each a COMPLETED document of the session's knowledge base. Empty or absent means the whole knowledge base. A replayed turn (Idempotency-Key) keeps the scope stored with the original request.

SsoExchangeRequest.description: One-time PKCE authorization code handed to the backend for the server-side Keycloak exchange (code and verifier never leave this call; the browser never sees any client secret).

RegisterRequest.description: Self-registration request. Honored only while the organization enables self-registration; otherwise the API answers 409. The account joins the default workspace and every public workspace.

LoginRequest.description: Password login with the organization account email.

rememberMe.description: When true the refresh cookie lasts `jwt.expiry-days`; otherwise it is a session cookie.

AcceptInvitationRequest.description: Creates the member account from an invitation token and issues the credential pair.

token.description: Invitation token from the invite email link.

password.description: Initial password (8–128 characters); not forced to change later.

ChangePasswordRequest.description: Self-service password change; also completes the forced change required after an administrator-set initial password.

currentPassword.description: The caller's current password; for a first forced change, the administrator-set initial password.

CreateWebhookRequest.description: Register a webhook endpoint that receives signed events.

events.description: Optional event whitelist; empty or absent receives every event. Known types: document.status.changed, workflow.started, workflow.approved, workflow.rejected, workflow.escalated, webhook.test.

CreatedWebhook.description: Creation response: `secret` is the signing key shown exactly once — store it now; webhook deliveries signed with it carry `X-OpenVie-Signature: t=...,v1=...`.

WebhookEndpointView.description: One webhook endpoint. Secrets are write-only.

CreateApiKeyRequest.description: Create a machine-to-machine credential for one workspace.

name.description: Display name, shown in listings and in the service-member profile.

role.description: Workspace authority of the key: WORKSPACE_ADMIN or MEMBER.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiry; after this instant the key answers 401.

ApiKeyView.description: One API key, masked. Secrets are write-only.

keyPrefix.description: `ovk_` + first secret characters, for identification only.

expired.description: True when the key can no longer authenticate (revoked or expired).

CreatedApiKey.description: Creation response: `key` is the secret shown exactly once — store it now.

StatusUpdateRequest.description: Account status change (owner only): ACTIVE or INACTIVE.

RoleUpdateRequest.description: Role change for one workspace member.

role.description: New workspace role: ADMIN or MEMBER.

WorkspaceTasks.description: The caller's task inbox: tasks assigned to them plus unclaimed candidate-group tasks.

EngineTaskView.description: The task inbox of one workspace across every definition (including the approval flow, exposed read-only).

assignee.description: User id the task is claimed for, or null when unassigned.

approvalDomain.description: Approval-flow tasks are journaled by the approval endpoints and refused here.

EngineProcessHistoryView.description: Terminal state of one process instance.

ended.description: True when the instance reached its end (for Approval this is the decision).

durationMs.description: Duration between start and end in ms; null while running.

DirectoryResponse.description: Workspace member directory plus pending invitations.

DocumentListItemResponse.description: One row of a knowledge base's document list. `jobId` links the document to its ingestion job; `chunkCount` is populated once indexing has finished.

status.description: Ingestion state: PENDING, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, or FAILED.

textSource.description: How the text was obtained: text (native layer), ocr (recognized page images), or mixed. Absent for legacy documents.

pageCount.description: Number of source pages when known (PDF and images).

errorMessage.description: Set when ingestion FAILED; explains the worker-side reason.

DocumentStatusResponse.description: Ingestion status of one document — poll while a fresh upload is still being indexed. Selectable as chat scope only in COMPLETED state.

status.description: Ingestion state: PENDING, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, or FAILED.

approvalStatus.description: Approval state written back by the workflow engine: absent when the document was never submitted, PENDING while a process is open, then APPROVED or REJECTED.

approvalTarget.description: Publish target chosen at submission: workspace, shared, or public. Absent until the document is submitted for approval.

textSource.description: How the text was obtained: text (native layer), ocr (recognized page images), or mixed. Absent for legacy documents.

pageCount.description: Number of source pages when known (PDF and images).

errorMessage.description: Set when ingestion FAILED; explains the worker-side reason.

CitationImageDto.description: A citable image backing a chat citation.

media_id.description: Key suffix under the document's media/ storage namespace.

CitationResponse.description: One retrieval citation backing an answer. Multi-modal extras (sheet, table, image fields) are null unless the cited unit has that modality.

source_name.description: File name of the cited document.

chunk_index.description: 0-based position of the chunk inside the document.

snippet.description: Short text excerpt of the cited passage.

modality.description: Unit modality: TEXT, IMAGE, TABLE, or similar.

parser_version.description: Ingestion parser that produced the cited unit (ocr-v1 marks OCR-derived text).

image.description: The cited image when the unit was derived from a persisted picture; media_id inserts into /api/v1/documents/{id}/media/{media_id}.

MessageResponse.description: A stored chat message (user or assistant) with its position in the session history.

sequence_number.description: 1-based position within the session; pass it as `after` when paging history.

PlaygroundSessionResponse.description: One row of the playground session overview.

WebhookDeliveryView.description: One delivery attempt record of the outbox.
